source_repositories.label: VORON Trident R2
source_repositories.author: VoronDesign
source_repositories.scope: Independent standard Trident 250 / 300 / 350 chassis, fixed frame, three Z guides, moving bed and 6 mm R2 gantries.
source_repositories.changes: Rigid native hardware retains its dimensions. Size-specific rails preserve native periodic hole pitch and fixing axes. Extrusions, bed and panels use central or perimeter inserts. Static mounting references and native Z limits remain disclosed.

source_repositories.label: Stealthburner / Clockwork 2 / Revo CAD
source_repositories.author: VoronDesign
source_repositories.scope: SBのRevo Voron・Rapido HF・Dragon SF/HF・V6用CW2マウント、前面本体、CW2修復用形状。
source_repositories.changes: 配置・表示用三角形化・配色の調整。機種ごとの変更履歴を検証記録に保存。

notices: Custom dimensions derived from native VORON 350 mm reference parts. Rigid hardware retains native dimensions.
Printed skirt sections are extended custom parts. This is not an official VORON size or a tested build kit.
Moving belts are smooth route previews; teeth, tension and electrical wiring mechanics are not simulated.
Custom Trident top panel has a 4.4 mm stationary PTFE feedthrough. The 4 × 3 mm tube connects the measured CW2 inlet and native spool-side holder; motion is a route preview.
Native lower Z-chain bracket is widened by a plain 50 mm section to retain the original lower-chain screw and insert interfaces. Rigid screw/insert dimensions are preserved.
Three upper rear Z-rail T-nuts and their rail screws are omitted above the shortened guide. Remaining rail hardware retains its original spacing and native dimensions.
Native three-WAGO printed mount has custom plain-section extensions to follow the rear and left extrusion seats. Original connector, screw and mounting-end geometry is retained.
The active two-hole lower Z-chain bracket uses its two measured insert sockets. Three inactive insert instances from the alternate three-hole mounting variant are omitted.

PTFE v2: spool-side tube terminates inside the measured 4.2 mm native holder bore; the old floating endpoint is corrected. Flexible movement remains a geometric preview, without constant-length or bend-radius certification.
